messages:
Tao: heads-up: weird edge-case in jsonMode + function_call + auth-retry. when the SDK refreshes token during a streaming function call, the joiner replays the last partial chunk and we end up with duplicated object fragments that fail strict schema validation on the server. repro below.

Tao: repro (node quickstart):
```js
const sdk = new RedwoodSDK({ jsonMode: true, streaming: true });
await sdk.chat.complete({
  model: 'rw-small',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'compute sum' }],
  functions: [{ name: 'sum', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { a: { type: 'number' }, b: { type: 'number' } }, required: ['a','b'] } }],
  function_call: { name: 'sum' }
});
```

Tao: trigger: run quickstart with a short-lived token and force a refresh mid-stream (we used a proxy that returns 401 on the 2nd chunk).

Tao: observed wire/assembled: 
```
chunks: '{"name":"sum","arguments":{"a":1', ',"b":2}}'
replayed chunk on retry: '{"name":"sum","arguments":{"a":1}'
assembled final: '{"name":"sum","arguments":{"a":1,"b":2}}{"name":"sum","arguments":{"a":1,"b":2}}'
server: schema error: expected single object but got multiple objects
```

Ivy: oof. so retry layer is re-sending previously-joined fragment rather than resuming idempotently. which sdk and samplekit?

Tao: js-sdk@0.9.4, samplekit v0.18-bootcamp, local quickstart. py-sdk users haven't hit this because py joiner uses an idempotent chunk sequence id; js earlier didn't include sequence ids in stream.

Marta: probable fix paths: 1) make streaming chunks idempotent by adding monotonic sequence IDs so retries can dedupe, 2) have retry layer re-request from the server a fresh stream instead of replaying partial assembled bytes, 3) defensive server-side: reject concatenated objects when jsonMode strict. prefer 1+2.

Ivy: short-term workaround for instructors: set REDWOOD_SDK_NO_RETRY=1 in quickstart container so token refresh won't trigger automatic replay during labs. also add a note in bootcamp README.

Tao: opened draft PR with sequence-id change in sdk/streaming/protocol.ts and retry guard in sdk/retry/restore.ts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/298 (WIP). PR also includes a small e2e that simulates mid-stream 401 and asserts single object delivered.

eng-oncall-bot: ci: samplekit-integration build #334 queued (logs: https://ci.internal/samplekit/334)

Marta: once PR lands, let's cut a patch and update onboarding image. also add a lightweight parity test between js and py that simulates auth refresh during streaming.

Ivy: agreed. long-term we should document jsonMode tradeoffs with retries and include recommended flags for bootcamp (no-retry / permissive parsing).

Tao: thanks team. i'll follow up with test artifacts and a short troubleshooting blurb for the instructors doc. will mark P1 for the next sprint if we can't ship a patch before the next cohort. :+1:
